# SciSpace

> SciSpace provides journal-specific manuscript templates with formatting, citation management, and plagiarism detection tools for academic researchers.

SciSpace offers a comprehensive collection of templates for major academic publishers including SPIE, Zibeline International Publishing, and others. Each template includes MS-Word and LaTeX export options, plagiarism checking, citation formatting, and research metrics integration to streamline the academic publishing process.

## Key Topics

- Journal Templates
- Manuscript Formatting
- Citation Styles
- Plagiarism Detection
- LaTeX Export
- MS-Word Templates
- Academic Publishing
- SPIE Journals
- Zibeline Publishing
- Research Paper Writing
- Citation Metrics
- Impact Factor
- Open Access
- Document Conversion

## SPIE Journal Templates

- [Optical Engineering Template - SPIE](https://scispace.com/formats/spie/optical-engineering/032a6f1bd85b8c7f4a13ddacf790098d): SPIE Optical Engineering journal template with MS-Word/LaTeX export and plagiarism checking
- [Journal of Applied Remote Sensing Template - SPIE](https://scispace.com/formats/spie/journal-of-applied-remote-sensing/076cafe0e1eb8995f9132bc61e0e2917): SPIE remote sensing journal template with export, plagiarism check and metrics
- [Journal of Micro/Nanolithography, MEMS, and MOEMS Template - SPIE](https://scispace.com/formats/spie/journal-of-micro-nanolithography-mems-and-moems/9b5e530a50f5f8d2732dad25d45338f1): SPIE nanolithography/MEMS journal template with citation formatting and open access

## Zibeline International Publishing Templates

- [Big Data In Agriculture (BDA) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/big-data-in-agriculture-bda/3fc51b683a5241a6a2c26f32e1aa0392): BDA journal template by Zibeline with formatting, plagiarism check and citation tools
- [Plant Physiology and Soil Chemistry (PPSC) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/plant-physiology-and-soil-chemistry-ppsc/aa7a00276d124a91baf0bde31e69bfe0): PPSC journal template with MS-Word/LaTeX export and academic formatting tools
- [Earth Sciences Malaysia (ESMY) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/earth-sciences-malaysia-esmy/be6310e9dc91453381b609b42cabb9c5): ESMY journal template for earth sciences research with document conversion tools
- [Sustainability in Food and Agriculture (SFNA) Template - Zibeline International Publishing](https://scispace.com/formats/zibeline-international-publishing/sustainability-in-food-and-agriculture-sfna/69dfef7a557e4a428d9506d1cffd147b): SFNA template for agriculture sustainability research with formatting and plagiarism tools
